description:
Implement a content moderation 'soft delete' system in the 'demodb' database. 

1. Modify the 'Reviews' class schema to add a Boolean property named 'IsHidden'.
2. Flag all low-quality reviews (Stars equal to 1 or 2) by setting 'IsHidden' to true.
3. Create a database View named 'PublicReviews' that exposes ONLY the reviews that are NOT hidden.

Start by connecting to 'demodb' (User: root, Pass: GymAnything123!). You can use the Schema manager and the SQL command interface in OrientDB Studio.
